title: Add thread safety to MemoryIndex
description:
P1 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-001). MemoryIndex uses plain Dictionary and HashSet with no locking. Concurrent Add/Remove/Rebuild from multiple callers (memory CRUD + maintenance) can corrupt internal state. Replace with ConcurrentDictionary or add ReaderWriterLockSlim.

File: MemorySmith.Core/Indexing/MemoryIndex.cs (lines 7-9)
Confidence: 95%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md
